name: Find Stock Photos with Pexafy
tagline: Guidance for finding, choosing and crediting free stock photos with the Pexafy Stock Photos MCP server
description: Usage guidance for the Pexafy Stock Photos MCP server: when a request calls for real photographs, which search to run (by description, by reference image or by a Pexafy photo), how to write effective searches and shape filters, and how to deliver each photo with its licence and credit line. Requires the Pexafy Stock Photos MCP server.
